помилувати.text:
Etymology tree
Proto-Indo-European *h₂ep
Proto-Indo-European *-o
Proto-Indo-European *h₂epó
Proto-Indo-European *h₂pó
Proto-Balto-Slavic *pa

Ukrainian по- (po-)
Ukrainian ми́лувати (mýluvaty)
Ukrainian помилувати
From по- (po-) + ми́лувати (mýluvaty). Compare Russian поми́ловать (pomílovatʹ), Belarusian памі́лаваць (pamílavacʹ), Polish pomiłować, Old Church Slavonic помиловати (pomilovati).

sources.quote: Inherited from Old Ruthenian столецъ (stolecʹ, “chair”), from Old East Slavic стольць (stolĭcĭ, “chair”), from Proto-Slavic *stolьcь. By surface analysis, стіл (stil) + -ець (-ecʹ).

стілець.text: Inherited from Old Ruthenian столецъ (stolecʹ, “chair”), from Old East Slavic стольць (stolĭcĭ, “chair”), from Proto-Slavic *stolьcь. By surface analysis, стіл (stil) + -ець (-ecʹ).

sources.quote: From Proto-Slavic *ěskravъ (“sparky”). Related to Proto-Slavic *jьskra (“a spark”), *ěsknъ (“clear”). Cognate with Belarusian яскравы (jaskravy), Polish jaskrawy, Upper Sorbian jaskrawy.

From Proto-Slavic *ěskravъ (“sparky”). Related to Proto-Slavic *jьskra (“a spark”), *ěsknъ (“clear”).
